description: Run one of the editor's own Tools panel tools (Smoothing, Speed Limiter, Simplify and the rest) on an axis, as if the user ran it. read_script lists the ids and settings. Give from_ms and to_ms for one range, or leave both out for the whole axis. A tool marked needs ScriptCompiler Pro cannot run: tell the user it is part of Pro and do not copy its effect another way. Lands as one Undo step.

axis.description: Axis. stroke is the main up and down axis.
axis.title: Axis

editor_code.description: The editor code the user reads from the editor's AI panel under Your own AI, for example K7P4QX. Leave it out when connected with the account address.
editor_code.title: Editor Code

from_ms.description: Start of the time range in milliseconds on the video timeline.
from_ms.title: From Ms

to_ms.description: End of the time range in milliseconds.
to_ms.title: To Ms

tool.description: Tool id from read_script, for example smoothing.
tool.title: Tool

name: run_editor_tool
title: Run editor tool
